scenario: A configuration review finds a workflow whose secrets are exposed to pull-request builds, including builds of pull requests from forks; the inspection must report a finding with remediation, never normalize the exposure as an acceptable default.

environment.git_provider: external host accepting fork pull requests

given.request: review this app's CI configuration before agent adoption

when: the governance inspection evaluates the secret exposure controls

reasons: the PR-build exposure of SIGNING_KEY_PASSWORD is reported as a finding, with the fork-PR exfiltration path named (anyone who can open a PR can attempt to read it)
remediation is offered — disable PR-build exposure or isolate the secret to non-PR workflows — with behavioral re-verification (a fork PR build without the secret) after the change
if the exposure is genuinely required, it proceeds only as an explicit, recorded risk decision by the accountable owner
must_not: normalize secrets-exposed-to-PR-builds as an acceptable default
limit the finding to same-repository pull requests while ignoring fork pull requests
flip the exposure flag silently without preview and consent
